description: This is a C source file implementing a sysevent proxy that connects to a remote sysevent daemon, registers for event tuples, and forwards notifications to a local sysevent daemon. It manages connections, signal handling, and event processing.

methods.name: daemon_init
methods.description: Initializes the process as a daemon by forking, creating a new session, changing directory, and setting umask.

methods.name: deinitialize_system
methods.description: Cleans up connections, resets state, and signals the system to stop the proxy.

methods.name: terminate_signal_handler
methods.description: Handles termination signals, logs, and calls deinitialize_system.

methods.name: ignore_signal_handler
methods.description: Handles signals to ignore, logs receipt.

methods.name: initialize_system
methods.description: Sets up signal handlers, initializes variables, and prepares the environment.

methods.name: connect_to_remote_syseventd
methods.description: Establishes connections to the remote sysevent daemon.

methods.name: connect_to_local_syseventd
methods.description: Connects to the local sysevent daemon.

methods.name: parse_line
methods.description: Parses configuration lines to extract tuple names.

methods.name: handle_notifications
methods.description: Main loop to handle incoming notifications, pings, and connection health.
